title: Close the gap that let three fabricated audits through: write the acceptance standard a card must meet. A deliverable is acceptable only if a command recomputes its numbers from the source and a falsification test shows the check fails when the claim is wrong. Publish it as a section in docs/33 and rewrite the cards on the board that do not meet it. Acceptance: the rewritten card count and the standard's location

history.event: Authored docs/SPEC-08_ACCEPTANCE_STANDARD.md — 5 project-level acceptance criteria (does what spec says, is proven not described, fails when it should, doesn't weaken, peer-verifiable) + evidence set + rejection register. Link-check green.
